subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should experimental `claws export` support only complete, corroborated installed state now, with any drifted-state export deferred to a separately named snapshot mode and drift report?
rationale: The code can enforce either direction, but the distinction defines what a portable exported operating role promises and cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Exact state only
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed contract for incomplete or drifted installs and defer snapshot export to a separately specified follow-up.

options.title: Add explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Specify a distinct opt-in snapshot command or flag with a machine-readable drift report and documented non-reproducibility limits.

options.title: Pause the export slice
options.body: Hold the slice until the lifecycle stack and export semantics are approved together.

recommendation.title: Exact state only
recommendation.body: Keep the current fail-closed contract for incomplete or drifted installs and defer snapshot export to a separately specified follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment supplies the concrete product-contract alternatives that require confirmation.
